captions.detailed: A 3D-printable brass instrument mouthpiece, featuring a long, slightly tapered shank and a flared cup at the bottom. The exterior of the cup transitions into the shank with several decorative, concentric ribbed rings. The mouthpiece is hollowed out with a central bore going all the way through, opening up into a wide cup at the mouthpiece rim.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric brass instrument mouthpiece in OpenSCAD. The script should allow customization of key dimensions including the cup diameter, cup depth, rim width, throat diameter, and backbore/shank diameters, generating the final shape using a rotated 2D profile.
captions.factory: The script uses rotate_extrude() on a 2D profile to generate the 3D mouthpiece. This profile is constructed using a polygon defined by key coordinate points (such as CupTop, CupBottom, and various throat/rim calculations), combined with circle primitives for rounded rim and throat contours using a union operation. A difference operation then subtracts small circles from the outer edge to form the decorative exterior ribs. A separate mustache polyhedron is positioned on the rim using translate and scale.
